_comment: Copy this to ~/.morning-fairy/scout_feeds.json and keep only the feeds for your own stack (in that folder a plugin update keeps it). scout_feeds.py reads these after its built-in sources (GitHub trending, Anthropic and Claude news, a few AI engineering blogs). kind is feed (RSS or Atom), trending (a github.com/trending page) or sitemap (add "filter": "/blog/,/news/" to keep only those paths). lane is skills, stack or people, so the Scout can spread its finds across lanes. Every URL here answered with a feed on 25 Nov 2026.
